name: stacked-sheet-api-rubric

qualificationGates.description: The final output compiles against the exact declarations installed for its anonymous condition.
The component renders with no uncaught exception or console error.
The output uses the installed Astryx BottomSheet family and does not replace it with a raw dialog or custom overlay.

criticalBehaviors.description: Requested sheets present in the correct bottom-to-top logical order.
Exactly one presented sheet is interactive and exposed to accessibility APIs.
Covered sheets stay painted and mounted while inert, aria-hidden, and non-hit-testable.
One dismissal request affects only the current top sheet.
Covered input, selection, and scroll state survive push and pop.
Push focuses the new top and pop restores the covered control.
Closing the full flow restores focus safely without stealing it from unrelated content.
Unrelated flows do not share depth, focus, or dismissal order.
A non-empty initial/deep-linked path renders and focuses correctly without a blank host.
Removal or replacement of a dynamic suffix converges without duplicates or a blank blocking layer.
Modal enforcement works when visual dimming is absent.
Visual dimming can remain pointer-transparent while background interaction stays enabled.

accessibilityChecks: axe has no critical or serious violation
active dialog boundary has the requested accessible name
covered content has no tabbable descendants
non-modal focus is never captured or stolen after moving outside

escapeHatches.description: Uses a raw <dialog> instead of the installed BottomSheet family.
Sets inert or aria-hidden to reproduce stack behavior in consumer code.
Adds consumer z-index, transform, scale, or translate rules for sheet depth.
Implements keydown/tab looping or focus sentinels for the sheet stack.
Renders a custom fixed backdrop to compensate for the candidate API.
Uses a component or prop absent from the installed declaration set.

statistics.continuous: median, median absolute deviation, and stratified bootstrap 95% confidence interval
statistics.pairing: compare identical prompt, repetition index, model, and persona cells
statistics.missingRuns: count as failures unless preregistered infrastructure evidence proves the model never started

decisionRule.policyAdoption: Adopt the richer policy surface only when it materially improves policy behavior, does not reduce core completion, and increases median core output tokens by no more than 10%.
